messages:
marta: quick design check — form validation for the multi-step datasource setup. thinking inline errors for immediate feedback, but two concerns: (1) compact/dense forms + required markers feel noisy, (2) step 3 contains a destructive action (delete connector) that needs stronger confirmation than just an inline error. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX/connector-setup
kevin: +1 inline for discoverability. for dense layouts consider hiding the asterisk and showing "Required" text on focus or hover. reduces visual clutter. :thinking:
julia: dev note: inline errors are straightforward (aria-invalid + aria-describedby -> error id). still recommend a top summary on submit that lists all errors so users don't miss anything across steps. validate-on-blur > validate-on-type to avoid noisy UX while typing.
dan: accessibility nits: inline errors must be announced via an aria-live polite region and focus should move to the first invalid input on submit. asterisk alone isn't accessible — use aria-required="true" and expose "(required)" in the label for screen readers.
marta: specific destructive confirm options: (A) modal typed-confirm (type DELETE), (B) checkbox + strong danger CTA, (C) immediate delete + undo toast. thoughts?
kevin: typed-confirm is heavy and blocks flow for common tasks. I like checkbox + danger CTA for most cases; reserve typed-confirm for production-critical or irreversible resources. also consider showing a short list of what will be deleted (caches, policy bindings, etc.).
julia: implementation tradeoffs: checkbox is easiest, typed-confirm needs extra validation and e2e tests. undo toast is nice but doesn't prevent accidental loss by itself. we could combine: confirm modal with checkbox + undo banner after deletion.
dan: accessibility for typed-confirm: input must have a clear label and instructions, errors announced, and ensure focus management in the modal (trap focus, restore on close). also ensure the confirmation phrase is programmatically determinable for AT users.
marta: copy proposal for delete modal: "This action permanently removes the connector and all associated caches and rerouting rules. Type DELETE to confirm or check the box to acknowledge. This cannot be undone." prefer explicitness over vague "Deletes connector".
kevin: required marker idea for compact mode: hide visual asterisk, render a subtle "Required" microcopy under the label when empty + on focus. keeps layout clean but signals necessity.
julia: rollout plan: prototype hybrid approach — inline errors per-field + top summary on submit + modal for destructive step. I'll add aria-live hooks and a feature flag so we can A/B.
marta: agree. also add an experiment to measure dropoff in step 3 when we use typed-confirm vs checkbox.
dan: tiny a11y nit: ensure color is not the only error indicator (icon + text) and error contrast meets AA.
lina-bot: reminder: add checklist to the PR template: focus, aria-live, aria-required, error IDs, and e2e for typed-confirm if implemented.
marta: thanks all — let's sync tomorrow 11:00 for a quick review of the prototype. :thumbsup:
